entries.en: Come on, what’s the matter with you? Other kids bring tons of customers to their parents’ stalls.
entries.ro: Hai, ce-ai pățit? Alți copii aduc clienți cu zecile la tarabele părinților.

entries.en: My mouth is dry from all the yelling.
entries.ro: De atâta strigat mi s-a uscat gura.

entries.en: Then how come I haven’t sold anything today?
entries.ro: Atunci de ce n-am vândut nimic azi?

entries.en: How about we do a special offer? Like... two jackets for the price of... three?
entries.ro: Ce zici de o ofertă specială? Gen... două jachete cât trei?

entries.en: Wow. How did you get so smart? ‘Cuz it ain’t your daddy’s brains, that’s for sure.
entries.ro: Wow. De unde ai ajuns așa deștept? Că nu de la taică-tu i-ai luat, asta-i sigur.
